Which properties of aluminium make it useful in the manufacture of aircraft bodies?
1
It has good electrical conductivity.
2
It is resistant to corrosion.
3
It has a low density.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
